model.name: merge.toolbarMisclickLayout
model.description: Re-layout the merge toolbar to make a wrong click harder: 'N selected' stays on its OWN line directly under the 'Apply All' button, and the 'X/Y open conflicts' text moves DOWN to BETWEEN the down-nav (▼) and resolve (✓) controls as a NON-CLICKABLE buffer above ✓ (so aiming ▼ can't mis-hit ✓). Both counts still shown, just repositioned. IMPL-EDIT to renderMergeGutter DOM order (Impl e24dc98a) - refines R30.50-A compose.
